change_description: Material change: anode substrate switched from copper foil (9µm) to 6µm to increase energy density by ~3%. Supplier claims no impact to cycle life.

change_description: Fan bearing change from sleeve to FDB (fluid dynamic bearing) for improved acoustic performance at high RPM (reduction from 32 dBA to 28 dBA).

resolution: Conditionally approved pending DVT results. NRE approved, unit cost increase subject to validation.
lessons_learned: Heat pipe geometry changes cascade into multiple adjacent components — always evaluate full assembly impact before approving dimensional changes.

change_description: Spring contact force spec tightened from 0.8±0.3N to 0.8±0.15N to resolve intermittent contact resistance failures in high-vibration environment.

resolution: Approved after cost-benefit analysis showed reliability improvement justifies premium. NRE amortized into PPV.
lessons_learned: Spring contact force tolerance tightening should be validated with gauge R&R study at incoming inspection — measurement system capability often limits achievable tolerance.

change_description: DFM improvement: connector housing mold redesigned with improved venting, reducing short-shot defect rate from 0.8% to 0.1%.
